execution_contract: CPU smoke default. Formal native training requires explicit mode, steps and eligible scientific objective. Never auto-launch.

training.sampling: shared_periodic_AB: Hall eligible only; flight permutation -> horizon permutation -> uniform window; same index and seed for A/B
training.selection: fixed seeded validation subset; equal flights then horizons; source-scaled loss
training.average_dynamics_override: Set objective=average_dynamics explicitly; this does not test periodic A/B hypothesis

uncertainty_contract: Uncalibrated continuous independent diffusion PSD assumptions; correlated joint covariance; Gaussian harmonic expectation closure, not calibrated coverage

phase_contract.mechanical_assumption: Hall=0; increasing counts; upward motion begins after zero; no pi switching label
phase_contract.availability_assumption: Encoder timestamp + 20 ms guard; assumes work queue publication latency <=20 ms. Not a measured upper bound; offline research only.
phase_contract.frozen_contract_override: Overrides build_config.phase.wing_phase_history_allowed=false for PA-HBD only; frozen tables/splits/quality exclusions unchanged.
phase_contract.threshold_scope: Fixed sensor QC: 0.15 rad reference innovation, 50 ms gap, 500 ms recovery, 20 Hz count-rate sanity ceiling; not tuned by model error or absolute calibration.
